prompt: Jade races Orange around the block
title: The Big Block Race
irony: The fastest legs try to win the block race by rushing ahead, but Jade and Orange only truly win it by slowing down to cross the line together.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Lamps glow over the night street as Jade hops on a chalk start line and Orange stretches beside her.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Jade dares Orange to race around the block while Green clutches his book and worries about trying.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Black shouts his bet-you-can't dare and Yellow calls the start from her porch as neighbours gather.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The racers bounce at the chalk line chanting together as Yellow lifts her flag and the street cheers.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Jade sprints too fast around the first corner while Orange charges hard past her and misses the turn.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Both skid into dry leaves at the dark corner, tangled and laughing while Green shouts to slow down.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: At the halfway lamp the neighbours chant again as the racers untangle and jog back onto the road.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Orange catches his breath and sees pushing too hard takes the fun from running side by side.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Orange decides to pace with Jade to the finish so they cross the chalk line side by side.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: They run the last stretch stride for stride as the porch crowd roars them toward the chalk line.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: They cross the chalk line hand in hand while lamps glow and neighbours cheer their shared win.
